releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.25 adds automatic Arabic/English direction in Notes, a lightweight finger Sketch with pen colors, sizes, eraser and undo/redo saved inside the note, plus a tiny WhatsApp source cue beside Sent or Documents in File Search. Ordinary folders such as Screenshots, Camera and Downloads remain plain text. The v0.11.24 internal image preview and previous navigation/OCR simplification fixes are preserved.
